units.text: INT. CRYSTAL GLASSHOUSE - REGENCY MASQUERADE, 1815
A cathedral of iron and glass, lush with orchids and palm.
Lanterns swing among the leaves.
Masked guests drift through the greenery.
A string quartet saws in a bower.
LORD ASHBY (50s, silver domino mask, jeweled cane) leans on a pillar and watches the dance floor without blinking.
PHILIPPA (30s, green gown, peacock-feather mask) waits by a fern, gloved hands clasped.
RENWICK (40s, black mask, scarred knuckles) tops up his glass and wanders toward the quartet.
SIOBHAN (20s, servant's apron beneath a borrowed shawl) carries a tray of champagne.
QUENTIN (20s, harlequin mask, nervous laugh) pretends to admire an orchid.
MADAME DUPRE (60s, fan, gold wig) moves between the guests, whispering, never looking at any of them.
Ashby taps his cane twice.

Renwick sets down his glass and drifts toward the doors, Philippa slides behind a palm and takes a folded note from her glove, Siobhan lowers the tray, and Quentin, laughing a half-second too loud, bumps into Madame Dupre, who drops her fan and does not stoop to pick it up.
The quartet falters.
Madame Dupre. You are unsteady.
units.name: ASHBY

units.text: It is the heat, Lord Ashby.
units.name: MADAME DUPRE

units.text: Is it?
units.name: ASHBY

units.text: Take it to the gardener's door.
units.name: PHILIPPA

units.text: Yes, miss.
units.name: SIOBHAN

units.text: She pockets the note and slips between two guests.
Renwick turns at the doorway, sees her, and steps into her path.
Quentin snatches an orchid, snaps its stem, and tucks it behind his ear.
Ashby crosses the floor with the cane tapping once for every step.
Where are you going, girl?
units.name: RENWICK

units.text: To fetch more wine, sir.
units.name: SIOBHAN

units.text: The wine is that way.
units.name: RENWICK

units.text: She lifts the tray like a shield.
He plucks a glass, drains it, sets it back on the tray.
She does not blink.
Philippa emerges from behind the palm.
Madame Dupre has stopped whispering.
Ashby arrives.
Philippa, my dear. You've been missed.
units.name: ASHBY

units.text: I was admiring the orchids.
units.name: PHILIPPA

units.text: You are always admiring something.
units.name: ASHBY

units.text: Quentin takes three quick steps back.
Renwick takes one forward.
The quartet stops altogether.
In the hush, a glass shatters.
Siobhan's tray is on the floor.
She and Renwick stare at the shards.
Ashby offers Philippa his arm.
She takes it.
Madame Dupre retrieves her fan and fans herself slowly.
Quentin laughs once, then thinks better of it.
Shall we dance?
units.name: ASHBY

units.text: Of course.
units.name: PHILIPPA

units.text: The quartet resumes.
Couples reform.
Siobhan kneels among the broken glass and, under the cover of the music, closes her fist around a small gold key.
